text: [lang:common]Sanctuary...[/lang] you must find it. My family, they are in the capital. Please, find the [lang:common]Sanctuary[/lang]. For them. [lang:common]Sanctuary.[/lang]
You don't see many strangers around here these days.
Safe travels out there. Watch the treeline after dark.
I have nothing more to say.
Hello, traveler. The mold in this valley makes my lungs ache.
We saw the shipwreck from the coast. There are rarely survivors on these shores. The mist swallows them.
Praise be the old gods, we still have stores of amber to keep the village lit for a few more seasons. But the mist will take us, that is sure.
I’ve heard tell of it. But if it’s out there it’s beyond beast infested lands. No mudman would make the trek. Our lives are measured in amber.
Do you speak the common tongue?
My ship wrecked off the shore. I need help.
A man on the shore kept saying “Sanctuary”. Do you know what this is?
Can I interest you in some goods?
I’ve been to the swamp. It’s hot.
I… I don’t know where I am.
Ah, common tongue. You’ve crossed into dangerous lands. But you can rest here in Whittlebone.
Yes. The Mist will make this place uninhabitable soon. But it’s safe for now. Not many speak common tongue though. You’d do best to learn our customs. Here, take this.
I am busy now, commoner. I must watch the sea.
